en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small domed building with a cross on top and, behind it, a slender turret-like minaret with windows and a pointed roof. Leafless trees and an iron fence stand in front of the structure, suggesting a winter or early-spring scene. The reverse side is a divided-back postcard layout with printed Hungarian text identifying the place and a date note from 1933.
